title: Jab mehfil-e-yazeed mein daakhil harum huvey
body:
Jab mehfil-e-yazeed mein daakhil harum huvey
Ghash aaya har qadam pah yeh zulm-o-sitham huvey
Zainab pukaari haadeisay aisey bhi kam huvey
Sar katt gaya Hussain ka sar nangay hum huvey
<<MINI>>
Kyon aasmaan gir nahin paddtha duhaayi hai
Zehra ki beti saamney haakim kay aayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Moujood anjuman mein sagheer-o-kabeer hain
Haakim kay girdh kursiyoun pah sab ameer hain
Khaasaan-e-Zuljalaal zaleel-o-haqeer hain
Mushkil kusha kay khurd-o-kalaan sab aseer hain
<<MINI>>
Kehdey koyi Ali sey yeh daarus salaam mein
Zainab ka daakhila huva darbaar-e-aam mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye logou Karbala sey meray bhaayi ko bulaao
Aye logou meray gaysuoun waaley jawaan ko laao
Aye logou mera haadeisa Abbas ko sunaao
Aye logou yaadgaar-e-Hasan sey kaho kay aao
<<MINI>>
Qasim sey haaye kuch na kamakh us ghadi huvi
Yeh baal kholay kiski dulhan hai khadi huvi
<<DIVIDER>>
Hokar aseer dukhtar-e-khaatam jo aayi thi
Naana ney meray khud isey chaadar uddhaayi thi
Poshaak amma ney nayee isko pinhaayi thi
Sabko yeh paas tha kay saqi ki woh jaayi thi
<<MINI>>
Ummath ko haaye pass Rasool-e-Khuda nahin
Zainab barhainaa sar hai aur unko hayaa nahin
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ko meray pooch toh kaisa saqi hai woh
Mushkil kusha hai kul ka Khuda ka wali hai woh
Naana ko meray dekho kay sab ka wali hai woh
Bhaayi kay sadqey faqr-e-Nabi-o-Ali hai woh
<<MINI>>
Meri khabar aseeri mein leytha nahin koyi
Kapdaa bhi mooh chupaaney ko deytha nahin koyi
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbaar mein yazeed kay harsoo tha izdihaam
Tehraa rahey thay baidh kay maanind khaas-o-aam
Baitta tha taqth-e-nehas pah woh nuthfaa-e-haraam
Ek haath mein toh sheesha tha ek haath mein tha jaam
<<MINI>>
Baalaa-e-taqth shughal tha isko sharaab ka
Aur zeir-e-taqth sar tha khalaf-e-Buturaab ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Haazir wahaan tha ek farangi bhi us ghadi
Rokar kahaa yazeed sey isney kay aye shaqi
Teiray maamailey sey laraztha hai mera ji
Sar hai tabaq mein jiska yeh mujrim hai kya koyi
<<MINI>>
Haasha jo mein kahoon kay yeh ahley qasoor hai
Zulfoun mein boo-ey mashk hai chehray pah noor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teiray maamailey sey mera housh jaata hai
Kya harf-e-badh tujhey yeh kattaa sar sunaatha hai
Jo choob baidh iskay labboun par lagaatha hai
Koyi bhi haath murdeh kay sar par utthaatha hai
<<MINI>>
Iska gunaah toh mujhey hairaan kar gayaa
Baaqi qasaas rehgaya aur sar utar gaya
